alertDefProperties.name: [cms-local] cms-postgres FATAL errors > 10 in 5 min
alertDefProperties.description: P1 · owning team: cms-platform (routing.team, Cases routed by router cms-platform to #production-alerts). More than 10 PostgreSQL FATAL logs (severity Critical) from cms-demo/cms-postgres in cluster cms-local within 5 minutes. Baseline is 0. Signature of the 2026-11-02 and 2026-11-03 incidents: 'the database system is shutting down', 'sorry, too many clients already' (SQLSTATE 53300), 'terminating connection due to administrator command', with pg_isready liveness/readiness probe timeouts restarting cms-postgres-0 and Npgsql exceptions in cms-backend. Dashboard: ${DASHBOARD_URL} · Runbook: spec/components/workshop-scenarios.md, INC-1 (cms_demo repo).
